audit.summary: Six bounded findings: four affect stated core proofs, constructions or an advertised explicit application; two concern local filtration or relaxation boundary statements. Several claims remain true after explicit repairs; the main maximizing-face theorem is not refuted.

Limitations: The general augmented proof of Theorem 6.3 has not been repaired; the counterexamples refute printed intermediate claims, not the final theorem.
Limitations: No independent comprehensive search of later journal corrections or full-text version correspondence was completed.

P1 — The augmented complex invalidates Lemma6.9 and a step in Theorem6.3 — Counterevidence: The final Theorem6.3 remains true in these examples because both full complexes are contractible. Correcting the order filtration does not remove this one-object counterexample.
P2 — Corollary9.8 uses the wrong exterior degree — Counterevidence: Lemma9.7 has wedge^(k-1), suggesting a transcription origin but not removing the substantive wrong calculation.

P3 — The flag-lifting induction asserts an unsupported intersection rank — Counterevidence: A specially chosen compatible lift works, but the original induction supplied only an arbitrary lift with target closure.
P4 — Lower-set subcomplexes do not isolate an object in the stated order — Counterevidence: The expected object filtration is obtained by upper sets; this does not refute minimal-complex uniqueness.

P5 — Relaxation statements omit orbit and empty-cusp boundary cases — Counterevidence: The subdivision is valid in the orbit example; the virtual representation identity in Proposition9.6 still holds there through Ind Res X=X tensor(1+sgn).

P6 — Euclidean unit normals need not belong to the rational determinant morphism line — Counterevidence: The real construction and intended virtual-character identity are not refuted; arbitrary rational rescaling is not automatically a chain-level repair.

proposition.claim:
Recorded check: The full augmented complex is P in degrees2 and1 with differential identity. Maximization gives F->F with identity, hence zero homology. Lemma6.9 predicts F[-1], with nonzero degree1 homology. A subdivision of [0,2] at1 gives the same failure in a nontrivial subdivision.

Finite face decomposition; P=[0,1], psi(x)=x; trivial subdivision explicitly allowed; F={1} is an internal face of Q_psi.

Recorded check: OS dimensions are (1,2,1) before relaxation and (1,3,2) afterwards. Printed wedge^2 of one-dimensional V[1,1] vanishes and predicts zero change; true change is t+t^2.

Gamma trivial, rank2 M=U1,{1,2} direct sum U1,{3}, H={1,2}, h=2; H is a stressed hyperplane.

Recorded check: Source/target rank F2 is2 and cl_M'(F2)={1,2,3}, but F1' intersect F2 is empty and has rank0, not k1=1.

M=U3,4; M'=U2,{1,2,3} direct sum U1,{4}; target flag {3} subset {1,2,3}; admissible F2={1,2}.

Recorded check: C^(<=a)=C^(<b)=0 and C^(<=b)=C, so C^b=C is minimal with nonzero differential, contrary to the asserted necessarily trivial differential.

Thin category a<b with unique nonidentity arrow f:a->b; C1=a, C0=b, d=f.

Recorded check: The orbit relaxation adds both12 and34 and yields U2,4, whereas Lambda_F adds only12; the resulting two-pyramid subdivision is not trivial. In the second case cusp is empty and Pi=Lambda is a boundary edge, not an internal cell.

M=U1,{1,2} direct sum U1,{3,4}; Gamma generated by(13)(24); F={1,2}. Additional case M=U2,3, F={1}.

Recorded check: Outward unit normal is ±(3,3,-2,-2,-2)/sqrt30. The rational functional x1+x2 vanishes on the facet direction space and descends to the rational quotient; its value ±6/sqrt30 is irrational, excluding even a rational coset representative.

Split P(U2,5) by x1+x2=1; the middle cell is P(U1,{1,2} direct sum U1,{3,4,5}), an internal facet.

repair.content:
Truncate first, then correctly track and restore the augmentation by a cone; the full argument is not supplied as proven.

Replace wedge^k by wedge^(k-1); general propagation follows Lemma9.7 wherever Proposition9.6 is valid. Its separate exceptional proof branch is not thereby repaired.

Choose nested target bases B_i adapted to the flag and set F_i=cl_M(B_i). Target independence implies source independence. Weak-map rank inequalities imply F_i subset F_i' and cl_M'(F_i)=F_i', including rank0/loops.

Use upper-set subcomplexes C^(>=X), C^(>X), or consistently reverse the order convention.

Treat singleton-orbit/trivial and complementary orbit cases separately; exclude or explicitly handle empty cusps. No fully general repaired relaxation theorem claimed.

Use outward primitive generators of the saturated quotient lattices L_N/L_N' with L_N=V(N) intersect Z^E. Determinant exact sequences make the two codimension-two composites opposite primitive generators; permutation actions preserve these generators. Compatible lattice volume forms identify the repaired complex with the signed incidence complex.
